headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of September 17, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY with an average return of 24.99% compared to SPY's 12.49%. This outperformance indicates that the portfolios are not only generating positive returns but are also providing a significant alpha of 12.51%. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved an impressive return of 50.72%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 7.30%, highlighting a disparity in performance among the portfolios. Such relative strength against SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's performance. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
